What we do

New websites, built from the ground up

No templates that look like everyone else's. Your site starts with your business — what you offer, who you serve, and what you want visitors to do.

Focused on new websites — for now

Right now Precision Web Concepts is taking on brand-new website projects — with the branding, features, and pages your business needs built in from the start, instead of a little of everything done halfway.

Custom Website Design

A site designed around your brand, your colors, and your customers — not a generic layout with your name dropped in.

  • Home, services, about & contact pages
  • Your branding, photos & story front and center
  • Clear calls, buttons & contact paths

Mobile-First & Fast

Most of your customers will find you on a phone first. Your site is built for that screen first, then scaled up to desktop.

  • Looks right on phones, tablets & computers
  • Fast load times, no clutter
  • Tap-to-call and easy-to-find contact info

Launch-Ready Setup

A website only helps if people can find it and reach you. Every build goes live ready to do its job from day one.

  • Search-friendly page titles & descriptions
  • Contact details & location easy to find
  • Walkthrough of your finished site at launch

Add to your website

Beyond the build itself, you can add these services to your project — pick the ones that fit your business.

Branding & Logo Creation

Don't have a logo yet — or ready for a sharper one? Get a logo created for your business, plus a consistent look — colors, fonts, and style — so your website and everything else match.

AI Chat Support

AI chat support integrated right into your website, so visitors can ask questions and get answers on the page — even when you're busy or closed.

Testimonials

Put the good things your customers say about you to work. Add a testimonials section to your site that showcases your real customer reviews where new visitors will see them.

Legal Documents

The legal pages a business website needs — privacy policy, terms, and similar documents — prepared and put in place as part of your build.

Instant Quote Calculator

Let visitors build their own estimate on your site — they pick the service and options, your prices do the math, and they get a range instantly. See it in the showcase above.

One more thing — a thank-you, on us

As a way of saying thank you: the legal documents your website needs — the kind that could cost you thousands if you had an attorney draft them, just those on their own — we are able to supply to you at no cost, through our partner attorney. Basically, it's our thank-you for choosing Precision.

More services are available

These are just the most requested add-ons. If there's something you want your website to do that isn't listed here, ask about it when you email support@precisionwebconcepts.com or fill out the brief form above — or call if you prefer. Chances are it can be built into your project.

How it works

From first message to launch day

A simple, straight-line process. You always know what happens next — and you do not need to make a phone call to get started. Filling out the brief form above is enough; a call is only there if you prefer to talk.

1

Fill out the brief

Start with the brief form above — your business, your customers, and what you want your website to do. That message on its own is enough to get started; no phone call is required.

2

We review & reply

Rob reviews your brief and replies to you with a design direction built around your brand and goals — and a clear price quoted up front before building starts. Half of the quote is required up front to get your project going.

3

Talk it through if you prefer

Optional, and entirely up to you: if you'd rather talk it through, you can call if you prefer — the number is in the header at the top and in the contact section at the bottom of this page. If you'd rather not call, that's fine — email and the form message already got things started.

4

We build & you launch

Your site is built mobile-first, with your content, photos, and contact details in place. You review it before it goes live — then your website launches, ready for customers, with a walkthrough of your finished site so you know how it all works.

Questions

Common questions

Do you redesign existing websites?

Right now, Precision Web Concepts is focused on brand-new websites. If you already have a site, email support@precisionwebconcepts.com anyway — or call if you prefer. In many cases a fresh, purpose-built site is a better investment than patching an old one, and we can talk through which makes sense for you.

How much does a website cost?

Prices vary depending on what you want — how many pages, which features and services you add, and how much content you already have. Every project is quoted up front before any work begins, so there are no surprises, and half of the quote is required up front to start your project. Email support@precisionwebconcepts.com or fill out the brief form to talk through your project and get your quote — or call if you prefer.

What extra services can I add?

Along with your new website, you can add branding and logo creation, AI chat support integrated into your site, a testimonials section for your customer reviews, and legal documents like a privacy policy and terms. More services are available too — if you have something in mind, ask about it when you email support@precisionwebconcepts.com or fill out the brief form — or call if you prefer.

What do you need from me to get started?

Just the brief form to start — no phone call needed. It helps to have your business name, what you offer, any logo or colors you already use, and photos of your work if you have them. If you do send photos, please add a short description for each one — what the photo shows and what work you did in it — because a photo alone doesn't always tell the story. The brief builder above has a description box for every photo, and is a quick way to pull those thoughts together before you send it.

Will my website work on phones?

Yes — every site is built mobile-first, so it looks right and loads fast on phones first, then tablets and desktops. Your phone number is tap-to-call, so a customer who finds you can reach you in one tap.

How do I get started?

Fill out the brief form on this page — tell us about your business and what you want your website to do, and we'll take it from there: we review it, reply to you, then design, build, and launch. A phone call is not required to get started. If you prefer to talk instead, you can call if you prefer — the number is in the header at the top and in the contact section at the bottom of this page — but that's optional, only if you want it.

1. Introduction

Precision Web Concepts ("Precision," "we," "our," or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, disclose, and protect information when you visit our website, contact us, request information, purchase services, or otherwise interact with our business.

By using our website or interacting with Precision, you acknowledge that you have had the opportunity to review this Privacy Policy.

2. Information We Collect

Depending on how you interact with Precision, we may collect the following categories of information:

Personal and Contact Information

  • Name and business name.
  • Email address.
  • Telephone number.
  • Mailing or business address.
  • Other contact information you voluntarily provide.

Business and Project Information

  • Business details and descriptions.
  • Project requirements and service requests.
  • Branding materials, logos, images, and documents.
  • Website content and other materials submitted for projects.
  • Communications, feedback, and project-related correspondence.

Payment Information

When you purchase services, payment-related information may be collected and processed through third-party payment processors.

Precision may receive transaction details, payment confirmations, billing information, and payment status. Full payment card numbers and security codes should be handled by the payment processor rather than stored directly by Precision.

Technical and Website Information

When you visit our website, certain information may automatically be collected, including:

  • IP address.
  • Browser type and version.
  • Device and operating system information.
  • Pages visited and time spent on our website.
  • Referring websites.
  • General website usage and interaction information.

The information collected depends on the website technologies and services in use.

3. How We Use Your Information

Precision may use collected information for legitimate business purposes, including:

  • Responding to inquiries and requests.
  • Providing estimates, proposals, and consultations.
  • Creating, developing, and delivering purchased services.
  • Communicating with clients about projects.
  • Processing payments and maintaining business records.
  • Providing website hosting, maintenance, and technical support.
  • Improving our website, services, and customer experience.
  • Troubleshooting technical issues.
  • Preventing fraud, misuse, and unauthorized access.
  • Meeting applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual obligations.

We will not knowingly use personal information for purposes materially different from those described in this policy without providing any additional notice or obtaining consent when required by law.

4. Artificial Intelligence and Technology

Precision may use artificial intelligence, automation, and other technology-assisted tools to support business operations and deliver certain services.

Depending on the project or service requested, information provided by clients may be processed through third-party technology providers, AI platforms, software applications, or automation services.

These tools may assist with design, development, content creation, analysis, customer support, and other business functions.

When using these services, Precision will take reasonable steps to select appropriate providers and handle information in accordance with applicable agreements and privacy requirements.

Information submitted to third-party AI platforms may also be subject to those providers' individual privacy policies and data-handling practices.

Clients should not submit sensitive personal information unless it is necessary for the requested service and appropriate safeguards have been established.

5. Cookies and Website Tracking

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to support website functionality, remember preferences, understand website traffic, and improve the visitor experience.

Depending on the technologies implemented, these may include:

  • Essential cookies required for website functionality.
  • Preference cookies that remember visitor settings.
  • Analytics cookies that help us understand website usage.
  • Advertising or marketing technologies, if implemented.

You can manage or restrict cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may affect some website functionality.

Where legally required, Precision will provide appropriate notice and obtain consent before using nonessential cookies or tracking technologies.

6. How We Share Information

Precision does not make personal information available indiscriminately.

We may share information with third parties when reasonably necessary to operate our business and provide requested services.

These parties may include:

Service Providers: Website hosting companies, cloud storage providers, software platforms, email services, and technical service providers.

Payment Processors: Third-party companies responsible for securely processing payments and related transactions.

AI and Technology Providers: Platforms used to support design, development, automation, and other requested services.

Professional Advisors: Attorneys, accountants, insurance providers, and other professional advisors when necessary.

Legal and Regulatory Authorities: Government agencies, law enforcement, or other parties when disclosure is required by law or reasonably necessary to protect our legal rights.

We expect service providers handling personal information on our behalf to use it only for authorized purposes and to maintain appropriate safeguards.

Precision does not sell personal information for monetary consideration. If our data practices change in a way that constitutes a sale or sharing of personal information under applicable privacy laws, we will provide the required notices and choices before engaging in that activity.

7. Client Information and Confidentiality

Precision understands that clients may provide confidential business information, proprietary materials, project files, and other sensitive information during the course of a business relationship.

We use such information to provide requested services, fulfill contractual obligations, and conduct legitimate business operations.

We do not intentionally publish private client information or disclose confidential project materials to unrelated third parties without authorization, except when required by law or otherwise permitted under applicable agreements.

Additional confidentiality obligations may be established through individual service agreements, nondisclosure agreements, or other written arrangements.

8. Data Retention

Precision retains personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, including providing services, maintaining business records, resolving disputes, enforcing agreements, and meeting legal obligations.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and the circumstances under which it was collected.

When information is no longer reasonably necessary, we will take appropriate steps to delete, destroy, or securely dispose of it, subject to applicable legal and business recordkeeping requirements.

9. Information Security

Precision takes reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information against unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, loss, and misuse.

Depending on the systems involved, these measures may include access restrictions, account security controls, secure service providers, and other appropriate safeguards.

However, no method of electronic transmission, internet storage, or data processing can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

While we make reasonable efforts to protect information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

10. Your Privacy Rights and Choices

Depending on your location and applicable privacy laws, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information.

These rights may include:

  • Requesting access to personal information we maintain about you.
  • Requesting correction of inaccurate information.
  • Requesting deletion of certain personal information.
  • Objecting to or restricting certain processing activities.
  • Withdrawing consent where processing is based on consent.
  • Opting out of certain marketing communications.
  • Requesting information about how personal information is collected, used, or disclosed.

Some rights may be subject to legal exceptions, verification requirements, and other applicable limitations.

To submit a privacy-related request, contact us using the information provided in the Contact Information section below.

We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests.

We will not unlawfully discriminate against individuals for exercising privacy rights available to them under applicable law.

11. Marketing Communications

If you receive marketing or promotional communications from Precision, you may opt out at any time by following the unsubscribe instructions included in the communication or contacting us directly.

Opting out of promotional communications will not prevent us from sending necessary service-related messages, payment notifications, project updates, or other transactional communications.

Precision is not responsible for the privacy, security, or content practices of third-party websites that we do not own or control.

13. Children's Privacy

Precision's website and services are intended for businesses, adults, and individuals legally able to use the services offered.

We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children under the age of 13 through our website without legally required parental consent.

If we become aware that personal information has been collected from a child in violation of applicable law, we will take appropriate steps to address the matter.

1. Introduction

Precision Web Concepts ("Precision," "we," "our," or "us") uses cookies and similar technologies on its website to support website functionality, improve user experience, understand website traffic, and, where applicable, support marketing activities.

This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how they may be used, and the options available to visitors for managing them.

This policy should be read alongside our Privacy Policy.

2. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that websites store on a visitor's device through their web browser.

They allow websites to recognize a device, remember certain preferences, maintain sessions, and collect information about how visitors interact with a website.

Some cookies are temporary and expire when you close your browser. Others remain stored on your device for a specified period or until you delete them.

3. Types of Cookies We May Use

Depending on the website's features, services, and integrations, Precision may use the following categories of cookies:

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are essential for basic website functionality, security, navigation, and other features necessary for the website to operate properly.

They generally cannot be disabled through our website's cookie preference tools.

Functional Cookies

These cookies help remember visitor preferences and settings, such as language selections, saved preferences, or other customized website features.

Analytics and Performance Cookies

These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website, including page visits, traffic patterns, and website performance.

This information may help us improve our website and services.

Advertising and Marketing Cookies

Where applicable, these cookies may be used to measure advertising effectiveness, understand visitor interests, or support relevant marketing activities.

These technologies may be provided by third-party advertising or analytics platforms.

4. Third-Party Cookies and Services

Some features or services integrated into our website may be provided by third parties.

Depending on the integrations enabled, these providers may place their own cookies or use similar tracking technologies.

Examples may include:

  • Website analytics platforms.
  • Advertising and marketing services.
  • Embedded videos or media.
  • Social media integrations.
  • Website performance and security tools.

Third-party providers operate under their own privacy policies and practices. Precision does not control all cookies or tracking technologies used by external services.

5. How You Can Manage Cookies

You can manage or restrict cookies through your browser settings.

Most modern browsers allow you to:

  • View stored cookies.
  • Delete existing cookies.
  • Block cookies from specific websites.
  • Block all cookies.
  • Receive notifications when cookies are placed.

Please be aware that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality or prevent some features from working properly.

Where required by applicable law, Precision will provide appropriate cookie preference and consent controls before placing non-essential cookies.

6. Cookie Consent and Your Choices

Depending on your location and applicable privacy requirements, you may be presented with a cookie consent notice when visiting our website.

Where applicable, you may be able to accept, reject, or customize non-essential cookies.

Strictly necessary cookies may still operate because they are required for essential website functionality.

You may change your cookie preferences through any available cookie settings feature on our website.

7. Information Collected Through Cookies

Depending on the cookies and technologies in use, information collected may include:

  • Browser type and version.
  • Device type and operating system.
  • IP address or approximate location.
  • Pages visited and time spent on the website.
  • Referring websites.
  • Website interactions and navigation activity.
  • General usage and performance information.

The specific information collected depends on the technologies enabled and how they are configured.

8. Data Retention

Cookies may remain on your device for different periods depending on their purpose and configuration.

Session cookies generally expire when your browser is closed. Persistent cookies remain until their expiration date or until you delete them.

Third-party providers may maintain their own retention schedules and practices.

9. Updates to This Cookie Policy

Precision may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in our website, technologies, third-party integrations, or applicable legal requirements.

Any updates will be published on this page with a revised effective date or last updated date.

1. Our Commitment to Accessibility

Precision Web Concepts ("Precision") believes that everyone should have the opportunity to access and use our website, regardless of ability or disability.

We are committed to making reasonable efforts to improve the accessibility and usability of our website and to providing an inclusive online experience for all visitors.

We recognize that accessibility is an ongoing process and that improvements may be necessary as our website, technology, and available standards evolve.

2. Accessibility Standards and Guidelines

Precision aims to consider recognized accessibility standards and best practices when designing, developing, and maintaining its website.

Where applicable, we use the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) as a reference for accessibility improvements.

Our accessibility efforts may include consideration of:

  • Keyboard navigation and accessibility.
  • Appropriate color contrast and readable text.
  • Alternative text for meaningful images.
  • Clear headings and page structure.
  • Descriptive links and navigation elements.
  • Compatibility with screen readers and assistive technologies.
  • Accessible forms and interactive elements.
  • Responsive layouts across different devices.

Our goal is to work toward accessibility consistent with WCAG 2.2 Level AA, where reasonably achievable.

3. Ongoing Improvements

Website accessibility is not a one-time task.

Precision may periodically review website content, features, and functionality to identify areas where accessibility can be improved.

We recognize that some website elements, particularly third-party integrations, embedded content, or externally provided tools, may not always be fully within our control.

When accessibility concerns are identified, we will make reasonable efforts to evaluate and address them.

4. Third-Party Content and Services

Our website may include content, applications, plugins, or services provided by third parties.

Although we may select and implement these services with accessibility in mind, we cannot guarantee the accessibility of content or functionality controlled by external providers.

We encourage visitors to contact us if they encounter difficulties accessing any third-party feature presented through our website.

5. Reporting Accessibility Issues

We welcome feedback regarding the accessibility of our website.

If you experience difficulty accessing content, navigating our website, using a feature, or obtaining information, please contact us.

When submitting an accessibility concern, please include:

  • The webpage or section where the issue occurred.
  • A brief description of the accessibility problem.
  • The device, browser, or assistive technology involved, if known.
  • Your preferred method of communication, if assistance is needed.

We will make reasonable efforts to review accessibility concerns and respond in a timely manner.

6. Alternative Access and Assistance

If any information or service on our website is inaccessible to you, please contact Precision.

Where reasonably possible, we will work with you to provide the requested information or assistance through an alternative method.

7. Changes to This Statement

Precision may update this Accessibility Statement as our website, accessibility practices, and applicable standards evolve.

Any revisions will be published on this page with an updated effective date or last updated date.
